item.title: How to Build a Personal Blog with Hugo
item.description:
How to Build a Personal Blog with Hugo

This tutorial walks through building a modern personal blog with the Hugo framework.

Prerequisites

Before you start, make sure you have installed:

  • (version 0.115.0 or newer)

Step 1: Create a Hugo site

First, create a new Hugo site:

hugo new site my-blog
cd my-blog

Step 2: Initialize the Git repository

git init
git add .
git commit -m "Initial commit"

Step 3: Add the theme

This blog uses the Academic CV theme from Hugo Blox Builder:

# Add the theme module
hugo mod init github.com/username/my-blog

Then configure config/_default/module.yaml:

imports:
 - path: github.com/HugoBlox/hugo-blox-builder/starters/academic-cv

Step 4: Configure the site

Edit config/_default/hugo.yaml:

baseURL: 'https://yourusername.github.io'
languageCode: 'en-us'
title: 'Your Blog Name'

Step 5: Create content

Create your first post:

hugo new post/my-first-post.md

Step 6: Preview locally

Start the local server:

hugo server -D

Then visit http://localhost:1313 to see the result.

Step 7: Deploy to GitHub Pages

  1. Create a username.github.io repository on GitHub
  2. Configure a GitHub Actions workflow
  3. Push the code for automatic deployment

Advanced configuration

Enable Chinese language support

Add the following to config/_default/hugo.yaml:

hasCJKLanguage: true

Custom styles

Create a custom stylesheet in the assets/scss/ directory.

Summary

Hugo offers a powerful and efficient way to build a blog. With sensible configuration, you can set up a professional personal blog that is easy to maintain.

Updated on December 23, 2025

item.title: My First Blog Post
item.description:
My First Blog Post

Welcome to my personal blog! This is the first article on a site built with Hugo.

Why Hugo?

Hugo is a static site generator written in Go, with several advantages:

  1. Fast builds — Hugo is one of the fastest static site generators available
  2. Easy to use — straightforward configuration and a gentle learning curve
  3. Plenty of themes — a large selection of high-quality themes
  4. Simple deployment — it generates static files that can be hosted on any static hosting service

How this blog was built

The steps were:

  1. Install Hugo
  2. Create a new Hugo site
  3. Configure the theme (Hugo Blox Builder)
  4. Customize the configuration
  5. Create content

What’s next

I plan to:

  • Share notes from technical learning
  • Record project development experience
  • Discuss research topics
  • Share occasional personal reflections

Closing

Thanks for reading my first blog post! If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to leave a comment or get in touch.

Published on December 23, 2025
